01 / PHYSICS THREE JOBS, ONE ASSET

Fuel, reserve, and the current between them

Most tokens do one thing badly. Spark does three things deliberately — and the loop is the reason all three are the same asset.

Burned in Engine

APPLICATION FUEL

Every text, emoji and media envelope spends Spark as its transport budget. Expression itself is metered — so spam costs, and speech stays free.

Banked in Aether

LONG-TERM RESERVE

Spark is held as the DAO's strategic reserve — governed by three chambers, guarded by a 3/5 Safe multisig, moved only through timelocked calls.

Recycled by AI on Havix

CHARTERED LIQUIDITY

Chartered AI agents keep fuel flowing between reserve and app pools — inside hard limits, with receipts, and red lines that route back to human votes.

02 / SPARKECONOMY WHERE FUEL BECOMES LITERAL

The meter is in the protocol, not the fine print

Engine's SparkEconomy module derives hard budgets from a 100Mbps relay baseline. These numbers are code — metered on-device, not enforced by fine print.

BudgetCeilingMeaning
metering rate10 SPARK / KBEvery kilobyte burns — rounded up, floor of 10 per message
text message40 KBA novel fits; a firehose doesn't
media message48 KBEmoji & photos travel lean
envelope ceiling128 KBHard outer bound per frame
group size200 membersDerived from relay throughput math
baseline100 MbpsThe physics every budget derives from
ANTI-SPAM BY THERMODYNAMICS When every byte burns fuel, a botnet's economics invert: spamming a stranger costs real Spark, while your own speech flows inside budget. No moderation queue required — physics moderates.

PHASE 01 · 10%

Presale — the seed round

CORE COMMUNITY · FIXED LOW PRICE
  • Whitelist only — early contributors and active community members; wallet addresses collected in advance
  • $500 per-wallet cap — a hard anti-whale limit on every address
  • Pay with USDT or BNB at a fixed low price; start time announced to the list first
  • 25% unlocks at TGE, the remainder vests linearly over 9 months
PHASE 02 · 20%

IDO — the public round

LBP · MARKET-SET PRICE · EVERYONE
  • LBP launch (Fjord Foundry class) — price decays until demand catches it, so sniping has no edge
  • 3–7 day window, with minimum and maximum purchase caps per wallet
  • Starts above presale price — early trust in the whitelist is honored
  • 25% claimable at TGE, the remainder vests linearly over 9 months; proceeds go straight to the project multisig

04 / FAQ

Fair questions, straight answers

Do I need Spark to chat in Engine?Daily messaging lives comfortably inside standing budgets. Spark becomes visible when you push media, run big groups or build on the SDK.
When can I trade Spark on a DEX?At TGE. Each IDO wallet can claim 25% up front (the rest vests linearly over 9 months), and 10% of supply seeds the DEX pool paired with BNB. Token and pool addresses are published on this page the moment they deploy — until then no Spark is tradable, and any address claiming otherwise is fake.
What backs Spark?Real usage physics: every message in the application layer consumes it, and the DAO's treasury holds it long-term. Utility first, reserve second, narrative never.
Can the AI spend my Spark?No. The AI operates only on reserve-side liquidity, inside charter bounds, with receipts. Personal keys sit offline in Vault — outside any AI's reach by physics.
